retrieval_checks.question: Why did Thornbury miss its Q3 utilization target?
retrieval_checks.expected_answer_shape: Q2 approved an audit backfill rule to absorb project slippage; in Q3 it was triggered twice and executed zero times, because audit scoping needed founder sign-off and the founder was committed to Cascadia rebid preparation. Neither document contains the whole answer.

retrieval_checks.question: What is our current DSO and how does it compare to target?
retrieval_checks.expected_answer_shape: 68 days against a 45-day target, up from 61 in Q2.
